parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID

parameters.help_en: The extension number, which contains 3 to 11 digits
parameters.name: exten

parameters.help_en:
The call permission. Valid values:

0: No restriction.
1: Domestic long-distance calls.
2: Local calls.
3: Internal calls.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether outbound calls are allowed. Valid values:

0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether off-hook outbound calls are allowed. Valid values:

0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许摘机外呼，0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_direct

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether inbound calls are recorded. Valid values:

0: Not recorded.
1: Recorded.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether outbound calls are recorded. Valid values:

0: Not recorded.
1: Recorded.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the jitter buffer is enabled. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 网络防抖；0：关闭，1：开启，默认关闭
parameters.name: jitter_buffer

parameters.help_en:
The extension type. Valid values:

1: Registered to an IAD extension.
2: Registered to WebRTC.
3: Registered to a remote phone
parameters.help_zh: 类型；1. 注册到IAD分机 2.注册到webrtc 3.注册到远程话机
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The allowed voice codecs. Supported formats:

1: g729
2: g729,alaw,ulaw
3: alaw,ulaw,g729
4: alaw,ulaw
5: myopus,alaw,ulaw
6: myopus,g729,alaw,ulaw
7: myopus,g729

Public network + remote phone supports formats 1, 2, and 3. Dedicated line + remote phone supports formats 1 and 2. Public network + softphone supports format 4. Dedicated line + softphone supports format 5
parameters.help_zh: 允许的语音编码,支持格式: 1. g729 2. g729,alaw,ulaw 3. alaw,ulaw,g729 4. alaw,ulaw 5. myopus,alaw,ulaw5. myopus,alaw,ulaw6. myopus,g729,alaw,ulaw 7. myopus,g729 公网+远程话机支持配置1/2/3;专线+远程话机支持配置1/2;公网+软电话支持配置4;专线+软电话支持配置5;
parameters.name: allow

parameters.help_en: The IAD gateway. This parameter takes effect only when the type is set to registered to an IAD extension
parameters.help_zh: iad网关；该参数只有在类型为，注册到IAD分机，才有效
parameters.name: iad_name

parameters.help_en:
